name: cccc-kernel-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is CCCC, a multi-agent collaboration daemon written in Python (package `cccc` under
`src/`). Its kernel keeps each working group's append-only event ledger, routes chat messages to actors, tracks read
cursors and attention acknowledgements, and stores the group's shared coordination context (brief, notes, tasks and
per-actor working state) that the daemon's `context_sync` operations edit.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is these Python modules: src/cccc/kernel/active.py, actors.py, agent_state_hygiene.py, blobs.py, chat_idempotency.py, context.py, delivery_policy.py, events.py, git.py, group.py, help_markdown.py, im_state.py, inbox.py, ledger.py, ledger_index.py, ledger_retention.py, ledger_segments.py, ledger_state_snapshot.py, ledger_status_cache.py, message_sender_snapshot.py, messaging.py, peer_insight.py, permissions.py, prompt_files.py, query_projections.py, recipient_syntax.py, registry.py, scope.py, settings.py, system_prompt.py, task_types.py and working_state.py; every module in src/cccc/contracts/v1/; src/cccc/daemon/context/context_ops.py; and src/cccc/daemon/messaging/inbox_ack_ops.py, inbox_read_ops.py and system_notify_ops.py. Together with them, the documentation pages docs/standards/CCCS_V1.md, docs/standards/CCCC_CONTEXT_OPS_V1.md and docs/reference/architecture.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.
